answer: For a summit on umber quarrying beside a wildlife haven, I propose one monthly vote per key reserving a distinct public IPv4 address. Auditors send fresh hourly TCP challenges, verify key-signed replies, and publish receipts; validators enforce one key per address per month. Each extra identity needs another address-month, paid in rent or forgone rental income; ports earn no extra votes. Missing or invalid receipts block that month's vote. Large address owners retain an advantage; colluding auditors can fake checks, and outages or shared connections can exclude honest users.
